# Stethos

> Self-serve MCP server (and REST API) for healthcare sales, marketing and investment teams, startups and their AI agents: current, sourced data on every US clinician, practice, health system and payer network, plus referral patterns, ownership (including private equity) and Medicare utilization, with a source and checked date on every field, verification agents, and change events. Priced per tool call. Tools: search_providers, enrich_provider, enrich_org, watch_providers, recent_changes. No patient data.

MCP endpoint: https://mcp.stethos.health/v1 (preview)

## Pages
- [Home](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/): what Stethos does and who it's for
- [How it works](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/how-it-works): connecting the MCP server, tool results, sources and change events
- [Solutions](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/solutions): medtech, pharma, health IT and services sales, healthcare marketing, investors, startups, post-acute care, clinical staffing, payers and directories, and health systems
- [Medtech sales](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/solutions/medtech): Find surgeons by specialty, procedure focus, affiliation and license, and get alerts when targets move. Provider data for medtech sales teams and agents.
- [Pharma and life sciences](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/solutions/pharma): Find prescribers by drug class and volume, map key opinion leaders, and get alerts when they move. Provider data for pharma commercial and medical teams.
- [Health IT and services sales](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/solutions/health-it-sales): Target health systems and practices by EHR, size and service line, find the right buyer, and get alerts on new leaders and new sites, for AI sales agents.
- [Healthcare marketing](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/solutions/healthcare-marketing): Build clinician audiences and account lists for campaigns, events and ABM, and keep them clean as people change jobs. Current, sourced healthcare data.
- [Healthcare investors](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/solutions/investors): Track practice roll-ups, clinician headcount and new locations as they happen. Real-time healthcare organization data for investors and corporate development.
- [Healthcare startups](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/solutions/digital-health): Find first customers and design partners, size your market and power provider search in your product, with one NPI-keyed API and MCP server.
- [Post-acute care and agencies](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/solutions/post-acute): More referrers than your marketers can cover? Rank the ones worth working, get nudged when one goes quiet, and map your network against the market.
- [Clinical staffing and recruiting](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/solutions/clinical-staffing): Source licensed clinicians by state and specialty, and spot health systems that are hiring. A real-time clinician data API for staffing platforms.
- [Provider directories and networks](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/solutions/provider-directories): Check provider directory listings against current sources. Flag stale locations, lapsed licenses and network mismatches with a real-time provider data API.
- [Health systems](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/solutions/health-systems): Map community physicians, their affiliations and Medicare volume around your hospitals, and alert physician liaisons when a doctor moves or joins a competitor.
- [Docs](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/docs): quickstart for search, enrich, organizations, watchers and MCP (preview)
- [Healthcare MCP server](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/healthcare-mcp-server): A self-serve MCP server for US healthcare provider data. Add it to Claude or Cursor in five minutes: search, enrich, organizations and change alerts.
- [NPI lookup API](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/npi-lookup-api): Look up any NPI and get more than the registry: licenses, affiliations, payer networks and practice contacts, each with a source and verified date.
- [Physician data API](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/physician-data-api): A physician data API with specialties, affiliations, state licenses and practice contacts for every US physician, plus webhooks when physicians move.
- [License data API](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/license-verification-api): Check physician and nurse license status across states in one API call, and get a webhook when a license is issued, expires or is restricted.
- [Health system data API](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/health-system-data-api): Health systems, hospitals, groups and clinics in one API: locations, rostered clinicians, leadership, open roles and ownership, with change alerts.
- [Medicare utilization data API](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/medicare-utilization-data-api): Procedure volumes, Medicare patients and Part D prescribing for every US clinician, from CMS data, resolved to one NPI record. MCP and REST.
- [Home health and hospice data API](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/home-health-hospice-data-api): Volume, payments, patient mix, star ratings and ownership for every Medicare home health agency, hospice and nursing facility, via MCP or REST.
- [Physician referral data](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/physician-referral-data): Map who works with whom: group rosters, hospital affiliations, ACO membership and shared practice sites for every US clinician. Referral flows planned.
- [Private equity ownership data](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/private-equity-healthcare-ownership-data): Which private equity firms own which practices, clinics, MSOs and facilities, in which markets. Owner, platform and add-on links with sources, via MCP or REST.
- [Use case workflows](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/use-cases): agent workflows by segment (medtech, pharma, health IT, investors, startups, staffing, post-acute care, health systems): medtech targeting, new-executive triggers, EHR campaign lists, ABM lists, KOL mapping, market diligence, portfolio monitoring, startup design partners, territory planning, event invites, CRM hygiene, staffing sales, post-acute referral development and physician liaison outreach
- [Data sources](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/docs#sources): NPPES, CMS Medicare utilization, Part D, post-acute and hospice files, Care Compare, Provider of Services, ACO participation, cost reports, MA enrollment, Open Payments, state licensing boards, payer directories
- [Pricing](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/pricing): per-tool-call credits; Free (1,000 credits), Build ($149/month) and Enterprise
- [Stethos vs Definitive Healthcare](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/compare/definitive-healthcare)
- [Stethos vs IQVIA OneKey](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/compare/iqvia-onekey)

## Guides
- [How to look up an NPI number, and what to do with it](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/blog/how-to-look-up-an-npi-number): Three ways to look up an NPI number, what each result tells you, and how to check that the record is still current before you act on it.
- [Your buyer changed jobs. Your CRM didn't notice.](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/blog/healthcare-buyer-job-changes): Healthcare buyers change roles often and CRMs rarely notice. Why titles go stale so fast, what it costs, and what keeps your contacts current.
- [What CMS ownership files show about private equity in healthcare](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/blog/cms-ownership-data-private-equity): CMS publishes who owns Medicare-enrolled hospitals, nursing homes, home health agencies and hospices, and flags private equity. What the files show.
- [What an MSO is, and why it changes how you sell to practices](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/blog/what-is-an-mso): More practices now sit under a management services organization. Here's what an MSO is, how private equity roll-ups use them, and how to work one as an account.
- [How to find out who owns a medical practice](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/blog/who-owns-a-medical-practice): A solo practice and a PE-owned one buy very differently. How to work out who owns a medical practice, step by step.
- [What the NPI registry can and can't tell you](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/blog/what-the-npi-registry-can-and-cant-tell-you): The NPPES NPI Registry is the backbone of US provider data. Here's what it reliably tells you, where it falls short, and what to pair it with.
- [Why provider directories go stale, and what keeps them current](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/blog/why-provider-directories-go-stale): Provider directories drift out of date because clinicians move faster than the systems that track them. Here's where the errors come from and what helps.
- [Giving an AI agent healthcare data: a checklist](https://stethos-one.vercel.app/blog/giving-an-ai-agent-healthcare-data-checklist): Before an AI agent acts on healthcare provider data, check freshness, provenance, identifiers, cost controls and patient privacy. A short checklist.
